theater: 長江下游采石磯與和州岸

battle.name: 采石之戰
battle.theater: 長江下游采石磯與和州岸
battle.brief: 隆興元年十月，金主完顏亮御駕親征，企圖架浮橋與攻城器械強渡長江直取臨安。中書舍人虞允文奉命督視采石軍務，收拾散卒、整頓陣容，以砲火與火攻焚毀渡江器材，宋軍大破金兵於采石磯。南渡計畫破產，金軍主力北撤，宋軍一度乘勝收復泗州等地，隆興和議遂以淮水為界。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰的雙方是金國與南宋。金方由海陵王完顏亮親自統帥，御駕親征南下：完顏亮於隆興元年自中都（今北京）率中樞主力南下，經河南、泗州一線直抵淮南，另遣偏師由襄漢沿江而下，另有自山東、遼東方向配合的部隊，並以海船組成的舟師由海道趨浙東，企圖多路齊渡長江、會師臨安。金國的指揮系統以完顏亮為最高統帥，樞密院掌軍令，中都留守司與各路統軍司分領兵權，攻城與水軍各有專司。宋方是南宋朝廷，時高宗趙構在位、已萌倦政傳位之念，皇子趙昚時封壽王，其後進封普安郡王，朝政由中書門下與樞密院分掌。隆興元年朝廷起用張浚主持淮上軍務，籌議收復兩淮，他旋因朝中主戰與主和之爭被罷，樞密使先後由湯思退、陳康伯擔任。邊軍方面，淮南兩岸各置統制官節制，采石為沿江軍寨，置兵不多；楚州一線由魏勝率軍固守，兩浙與沿海則有水軍巡防。實戰之中，采石一線的中書舍人虞允文奉命宣撫督視，實際接管了江上指揮。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Jin state and the Southern Song. On the Jin side the command belonged entirely to the ruler in person: the Prince of Hailing, Wanyan Liang, who led a personally directed southern campaign, moving the central army out of Zhongdu (modern Beijing) in the first year of Longxing, down through Henan and Suzhou to reach the Huai country; he sent a separate force down the river from Xiangyang and Han, further columns to support from the Shandong and Liaodong directions, and a fleet built from sea-going ships to approach Zhejiang from the sea, so that several armies would cross the Yangtze at once and meet at Lin'an. The Jin command system placed all authority in Wanyan Liang as supreme commander, with the Privy Council issuing the orders, the Zhongdu garrison administration and the several regional armies holding the troops, and separate directorates for siegecraft and for the water forces. The Song side was the Southern Song court, with Gaozong Zhao Gou on the throne and already thinking of handing power to his son, whom he had made Prince Shou and would later make Prince of Puan; the administration was divided between the Secretariat and the Privy Council. In the sixth month of the first year of Longxing the court brought Zhang Jun forward to direct the armies in the Huai and planned an offensive to retake the Two Huai, and he was removed shortly afterwards amid the quarrel between the war party and the peace party, the post of Privy Councillor passing in turn to Tang Situi and then to Chen Kangbo. On the frontier, command was held by the zhuangguan officers of the districts on either bank of the Huai; Caishi was a garrison town on the river with few troops in it, Wei Sheng held Chuizhou with his army on that line, and the coast of the two Zhejiang and the sea approaches were watched by the provincial fleet. In the fighting itself it was the Zhongshu Sheren Yu Yunwen, sent to pacify the district and supervise the river army, who actually took over the command on the Yangtze.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩方。宋方的核心是虞允文：隆興元年十月，他以中書舍人奉命往采石宣撫、督視軍務，到達時采石守軍兵寡且多新集散卒，諸將互不受命，虞允文當即收攏散卒、犒賞將士、分派任務，並自任前鋒督戰，軍心始定。相傳他見前線退卻時拔刀衝入敵陣奪取首級以激士氣，此役之後名聲大振，後世以之中興名將。樞密使湯思退主張退守和議，采石既勝仍被罷職，陳康伯接掌樞密、主持江防；原樞密使張浚在戰前被免，戰後隆興二年一度復出。金方由完顏亮全權統率，其人剛愎嗜殺，徵調全國精兵、耗盡府庫，執意御駕渡江；采石受挫後轉兵瓜洲，旋於隆興元年冬被其弟完顏元宜派將所弒，軍中秘不發喪，盡斂金帛、載運糧草北還。南宋降將劉整為金人獻策，力主速取江南並指出采石為渡江要衝；金人海上舟師在浙東澉浦一線遭宋軍擊退，金方多路齊進的企圖因此不能成合。楚州守將魏勝以少量兵力堅守城池，金主大軍久攻不下，一度成為金軍無法速決的第二個障礙。
peopleEn: The decisive figures belong to both sides. The heart of the Song side was Yu Yunwen: in the tenth month of the first year of Longxing he was sent to Caishi as Zhongshu Sheren to pacify the district and supervise the river army, and when he arrived the garrison was short of men and largely composed of newly raised strays while the commanders did not take orders from one another; he gathered in the scattered men, rewarded the soldiers, assigned tasks and took the vanguard into his own hand, and only then did the army settle. The account that has come down is that when the front gave way he drew his sword, ran into the enemy line and brought back a head to steady the troops, and after this engagement his name spread far and wide, later generations ranking him among the great generals of the Song restoration. Tang Situi, the Privy Councillor, pressed for a defensive withdrawal and a negotiated peace, and was removed even after Caishi had been won; Chen Kangbo succeeded him at the Privy Council and took charge of the river defence, while Zhang Jun, the former Privy Councillor who had advocated the offensive, had been dismissed before the battle and came back for a time in the second year of Longxing. On the Jin side all direction lay with Wanyan Liang, a ruler who was stubborn and bloodthirsty, who drew the whole strength of the state and emptied the treasury, and who was determined to cross the river in person. Repulsed at Caishi he moved his army to Guazhou, and in the winter of the first year of Longxing he was killed by officers sent by his own brother Wanyan Yuanyi; the death was kept secret, the treasure and the grain were loaded up, and the army returned north. The Southern Song turncoat Liu Zheng offered the Jin their plan, urging them to seize Jiangnan at once and identifying Caishi as the crossing of importance. The Jin fleet coming by sea toward eastern Zhejiang was beaten back by Song forces off the Huanpu coast, so that the attempt to converge from several directions could not be made. Wei Sheng, who defended Chuizhou with a small force, held the city against the main army of the ruler in person for a matter of weeks, and for a while he was a second obstacle that the Jin could not get past quickly.
kits: 配重投石車是這場戰爭的骨幹器械之一。中國式的配重投石車自漢代「霹靂車」一脈發展，十二世紀的《武經總要》已載其圖式；同一技術經中亞、西亞傳入歐洲，歐陸稱為trebuchet，義大利諸城邦自十一世紀末起就用它攻破城堡——卡面所標的一一〇〇年正是這一歐洲早期年代，而在采石江面實際運作的，是同一技術譜系的中國式配重投石車，兩者機械原理同源。采石一線配置的投石車架在磯石高處，以長臂拋射石彈，專打對岸集結的密集步兵、正在架設的浮橋與攻城器械，拋出的石彈重以數十斤計，各記不一，一發落地即可在人群中打開整排的空缺，也可直接擊斷橋面。兩軍都在用這類器械：金人以砲車轟擊采石軍寨與宋軍陣地，掩護渡江部隊；宋軍則以之壓制浮橋兩端的守兵。除投石車外，金人配備攻城塔、雲梯、衝車與填壕木柵，輔以火箭與火瓶火具；宋軍靠強弓與弩、束伍的長槍大刀列陣，並把漁船改作載兵的舟船，用火攻焚燒浮橋上的木料。運輸與補給同樣吃重：金軍騎兵與挽具馬隊自淮北運糧，舟師另備海船數百艘；宋軍糧秣由建康、池州沿水路輸送，江上各軍寨的儲備只夠數日。
kitsEn: The counterweight trebuchet was one of the backbone weapons of this war. The Chinese counterweight trebuchet developed in a line with the Han Thunder Crash chariot, and its diagram was already recorded in the Wujing Zongyao of the twelfth century; the same technology passed through Central Asia and Western Asia into Europe, where it was called the trebuchet, and the Italian city-states used it to breach castles from the end of the eleventh century on. The 1100 on the card is the date of that early European form, while the machine actually working on the water at Caishi was the Chinese-lineage counterweight trebuchet of the same family, the two being identical in mechanical principle. The trebuchets on the Caishi line were set up on the heights of the crag and hurled stones with their long arms at the dense infantry massed on the far bank, at the floating bridge then under construction and at the siege engines; the stones thrown ran to tens of jin in weight, the exact figures differing from account to account, and a single shot landing among a crowd could open a whole gap in a rank, while a direct hit could break the deck of the bridge. Both sides used this class of weapon: the Jin cannon worked on the Song garrison at Caishi and on the Song positions, covering their own troops in the crossing, while the Song used it to dominate the troops guarding both ends of the floating bridge. Besides the trebuchet the Jin brought up siege towers, ladders, battering rams and fascines to fill the ditch, together with fire arrows and incendiary pots; the Song relied on powerful bows and crossbows, on close-ordered spearmen and sabermen, and on fishing boats converted into troop-carrying craft, and they used fire to burn the timber of the floating bridge. Transport and supply were no less pressing: the Jin cavalry and the teams of draught horses carried grain down from north of the Huai, and the fleet had several hundred sea-going ships; the Song drew their grain and provisions by water route from Jiankang and Chizhou, and the stores at the river garrisons lasted only a few days.
tactics: 金人的戰術核心是一條大攻線配合強渡工程。完顏亮不求各路分頭渡江，而要主力先據楚州、瓜洲，再在采石江面架設浮橋，把攻城的雲梯、攻城塔與援兵整批送到江南岸；浮橋是先鋒，攻城器械是主力，兩者缺一不可。問題在於浮橋必須在宋軍火力之下完成，一旦被毀，全盤計畫即刻作廢。宋方的打法是守點、壓制、焚毀。虞允文先整頓采石軍容，把新集散卒編為隊伍，選取精銳分為數隊，以砲火與弓弩封鎖浮橋兩端，再用火船與火箭焚燒橋上木料，同時派小股精兵夜渡對岸破壞攻城器械，使金人不敢復用舊橋。金兵屢攻不克而士氣漸衰，完顏亮移師瓜洲，士卒在渡江無望之際被北撤的命令驅趕，全軍由攻勢轉為潰退，宋軍趁勢追擊至真州一線。海上另一路，金舟師由海道趨浙東，在澉浦遭宋沿海水軍與岸上弓弩截擊，舟船受創即退；宋軍並未深入追擊北去的金兵主力，而是依江防布置固守，把戰果轉成談判的籌碼。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the Jin plan was one great line of advance supported by an engineering crossing. Wanyan Liang did not mean to cross in detached columns; he meant the main body to seize Chuizhou and Guazhou first and then to set up the floating bridge at the Caishi reach, so that the ladders, the siege towers and the reinforcements could be delivered to the southern bank in whole loads. The floating bridge was the vanguard and the siege engines the main force, and neither could do without the other. The difficulty was that the bridge had to be finished under the fire of the Song, and once it was destroyed the whole plan was void in a single moment. The Song method was to hold the point, to dominate the crossing and to burn it. Yu Yunwen first reformed the garrison at Caishi, drew the newly raised strays into order, picked the picked troops and split them into several bodies, put gun and bow fire on both ends of the floating bridge, and then sent fire ships and fire arrows against the timber of the bridge, while small bodies of chosen men crossed by night to destroy the siege engines on the far bank, so that the Jin should not dare to use the old bridge again. The Jin attacks failed again and again as their spirit drained; Wanyan Liang moved to Guazhou, and his soldiers, by then driven by the order to retreat north with no prospect of crossing, turned from an offensive into a rout, and the Song troops pursued them as far as the Zhenzhou line. On the other front the Jin fleet came by sea toward eastern Zhejiang and was cut off by the Song provincial navy and by bow fire from the shore off Huanpu, the ships, damaged, turning back. The Song did not pursue the withdrawing main body into the north, but held the river defence in place and converted the victory into bargaining power for the talks that followed.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰役發生於隆興元年十月（公元1161年11月下旬），一般記作十月十九日前後；金人南下的總動員自隆興元年六月開始，至完顏亮被弒、金軍北撤而止，歷時約八個月。宋方文獻常以「百萬」概稱南侵之眾，此數顯係誇大，然金國可徵之兵確在數十萬量級，分為御駕主力、襄漢一路、山東遼東配合一路與海上舟師四路。采石一線宋軍的具體兵數各家記載不一，從兩萬到五萬都有，大致在數萬量級；虞允文初到時守軍寡弱，收散卒、建援兵之後才勉強成軍。金人在采石架設浮橋的數目各記不一，有稱三座者；金舟師出動的海船，宋人記為數百艘。楚州一線，孤軍在金主大軍圍攻下堅守數十日而城不陷。金主完顏亮於隆興元年冬在瓜洲被部將所弒，金軍隨即放棄淮南、載運糧草北返。隆興二年十一月宋金訂立和約，主要條款為宋稱臣、割唐鄧兩州、歲貢銀絹各二十五萬，兩年之後以淮水為界正式劃定疆界。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The action fell in the tenth month of the first year of Longxing, corresponding to late November of 1161, and is generally placed around the nineteenth day of the month; the general mobilisation of the Jin began in the sixth month of the same year and ended with the killing of Wanyan Liang and the withdrawal of their army, a matter of about eight months. Song documents habitually speak of a million men in the invasion, a figure plainly exaggerated, though the troops the Jin state could raise were certainly of the order of several hundred thousand, divided into the imperial main body, the column out of Xiangyang, the supporting columns from Shandong and Liaodong, and the fleet by sea. The exact strength of the Song force at Caishi differs from account to account, ranging from twenty thousand to fifty thousand, in general a matter of several tens of thousands; the garrison was weak and scattered when Yu Yunwen first arrived, and only became an army after he gathered the strays and brought up reinforcements. The number of floating bridges the Jin put up at Caishi is likewise given differently, three being one common statement; the sea-going ships put into the water by the Jin fleet are recorded by the Song as numbering in the hundreds. On the Chuizhou line a small force held the city for a matter of weeks against the main army of the ruler in person without its falling. Wanyan Liang was killed by his own officers at Guazhou in the winter of the first year of Longxing, and the Jin then gave up the Huai country and carried their grain back north. In the eleventh month of the second year of Longxing the Song and the Jin concluded a treaty whose principal terms were that the Song should call itself a subject, that Tang and Deng should be ceded, and that silver and silk should be paid yearly to the value of two hundred and fifty thousand each; two years later the frontier was formally drawn along the Huai.
cause: 起因是金主完顏亮一方的南下計劃與南宋的北伐籌劃正面撞在一起。金自海陵王即位後一心要一統南北，先是把都城從會寧遷到燕京，再遷汴京，把國家重心壓向南面；隆興元年他把宗室完顏元宜拘在汴京，清理異己，國內異議者眾，便以大規模南征作為轉移矛盾的出口。金人的算計是趁江南無備，以多路大軍同時壓境，速決於渡江一役；南宋降將劉整的獻策更指出采石一帶的守備空虛與渡江的要道。宋方在隆興元年六月起用張浚主持淮上軍務，籌議收復兩淮，被金方視為挑釁，戰事因而提前；此後宋廷在主力北伐與放棄兩淮之間反覆，主力北上、江防轉薄，采石、楚州等要衝的守兵被抽調與新募交替，防線實際上只靠幾處軍寨與沿江的民間武裝維持。金人一經登岸即可直取臨安，這是完顏亮堅持強攻的真正理由：不是佔領淮南，而是要藉一次成功的渡江終結南宋。
causeEn: The cause was the collision between the plan to invade the south on the Jin side and the Song offensive preparations. Since taking the throne the Prince of Hailing had set his mind on uniting north and south: first he moved the capital from Huining to Yanjing and then to Bianjing, pressing the weight of the state southward. In the first year of Longxing he held the clan prince Wanyan Yuanyi in Bianjing and cleared out those who disagreed with him, and since opposition at home was general he used a great southern campaign as the outlet for that tension. The Jin calculation was to fall on Jiangnan while it was unprepared and to end the war in a single day on the river; the advice of the Song turncoat Liu Zheng reinforced this by pointing out the emptiness of the Caishi defences and the importance of that crossing. The Song court in the sixth month of the first year of Longxing brought Zhang Jun forward to direct the armies in the Huai and planned to retake the Two Huai, which the Jin read as a challenge, so the war was brought forward in consequence. Thereafter the court swung between launching the main body north and giving up the Two Huai, so that the strength went north while the river defence thinned; the garrisons of the key points such as Caishi and Chuizhou were repeatedly stripped and refilled with new levies, and the line in fact rested on a few garrison towns and on the armed villagers along the river. Once the Jin were across they could go straight to Lin'an, and that was the true reason Wanyan Liang insisted on pressing the assault: not to occupy the Huai country, but to end the Southern Song in one successful crossing.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果直接決定了南宋的國祚長短。采石一戰破掉金人渡江的總計畫，完顏亮死於瓜洲，金軍把已攻克的淮北城池全部吐回，南宋得以再延百五十年，到一二七九年才亡於元。政治上，隆興和議之後宋金維持以淮水為界的相對均勢，宋廷以稱臣與歲幣換取邊境安寧，財政負擔沉重，軍費與歲幣並行，成為此後一百年的常態。高宗因這場勝利得以把政權交給趙昚，孝宗即位後不再輕言北伐，南宋的戰略從反攻收束為守江。技術上，這場戰爭是配重投石車與攻城工程最典型的一次對決：金人把全部希望押在浮橋這一件工程器械上，而工程一旦被砲火與火攻摧毀，數十萬大軍便在江邊滯留成僵局；同樣的道理在十二世紀的歐洲已有印證，當時西西里與北義大利的攻城戰裡，配重式投石車同樣是改變城防攻守的最後一環。對後世兵書而言，采石之戰也反覆證明了一件常被忽略的事：決定戰役的往往不是弓弩的射程，而是浮橋、壘土與糧道這些看不見的工程。
impactEn: The result of this war directly decided how long the Southern Song would last. The victory at Caishi broke the Jin plan for a crossing, Wanyan Liang died at Guazhou, and the Jin gave back every city of the north of the Huai that they had taken, so that the Song survived for another hundred and fifty years and did not fall to the Yuan until 1279. Politically, after the Longxing settlement the Song and the Jin held a relative balance along the Huai, and the Song bought peace at the price of calling itself a subject and paying tribute, the burden on the treasury heavy as the costs of war and the tribute ran together, the ordinary condition of the following century. Gaozong was able, on the strength of this victory, to hand power to Zhao Gou, and the new emperor Xiaozong no longer spoke lightly of northern expeditions, so that the strategy of the Song closed down from counterattack to the defence of the river. In technical terms this war was the classic duel between the counterweight trebuchet and siege engineering: the Jin had placed all their hopes on the floating bridge as a single work of engineering, and when that work was destroyed by gun fire and fire, the tens of thousands of the army were stranded at the river in a stalemate; the same lesson had its parallel in twelfth-century Europe, where in the sieges of the cities of Sicily and northern Italy the counterweight trebuchet was likewise the last piece to turn the balance of a besieged town. To the military writers who came after, the battle of Caishi also proved again a thing often overlooked: what decides a campaign is seldom the range of a bow, but the invisible works, the bridge, the rampart of earth and the road of supply.
result: 戰果：金人渡江失敗，宋軍在采石磯大破金兵，完顏亮的總攻計畫當場破產。金軍退保瓜洲，士氣崩潰，完顏亮被部將所弒，軍中秘不發喪，盡斂金帛北還，淮南與兩淮諸城相繼收復。隆興二年宋廷一度乘勝北伐，張浚復出主持軍務，收復泗州等處，卻因糧道不繼、士氣已疲而不能持久，兩淮之地終究無法久守，和議隨即取代戰爭。帝王層面的收束是：高宗退位，趙昚即位為孝宗，和議既定之後改元乾道，局勢就此固定。從裝備的結果看，這場戰爭給出的答案很清楚：配重投石車這類能跨越城牆與江面的器械，仍然服從於更大的工程紀律；金人備齊了投石車、雲梯、攻城塔與數百艘海船，卻沒有一條能讓數十萬人安全渡江的浮橋，宋軍則用砲火與火攻先毀了這條橋，剩下的攻城器械便全部成了廢鐵。之後兩國都沒有再有能力單獨發動大規模渡江作戰，宋金邊界因而維持了近百年的靜態平衡。
resultEn: As for the outcome: the crossing failed, the Song army broke the Jin at the crag of Caishi, and the general offensive of Wanyan Liang was ruined on the spot. The Jin fell back on Guazhou, their spirit broke, Wanyan Liang was killed by his own officers, the death was kept secret, the treasure was loaded up and the army went north, city after city of the Huai country being given back. In the second year of Longxing the Song court struck north for a time and Zhang Jun came back to direct the war, taking Suzhou and other places, but the supply line would not carry it and the troops were already worn out, so that the Two Huai could not be held for long, and a negotiated settlement took the place of the war. At the level of the rulers the business was closed: Gaozong abdicated, Zhao Gou took the throne as Xiaozong, and once the settlement was made the era name was changed to Qiandao, and the situation was fixed from then on. As to the equipment, this war gives a clear answer: the counterweight trebuchet, with all that it could throw stone over a wall or across a river, still obeyed a larger discipline of engineering. The Jin had mustered trebuchets, ladders, siege towers and several hundred sea-going ships, but they had no bridge on which several hundred thousand men could cross the river in safety, while the Song destroyed that bridge first with gun fire and fire, and every siege engine after that was so much scrap iron. Neither state afterwards had the strength to launch a large crossing on its own, and the frontier between them kept a static balance for close to a century.
